title: Workflow capabilities
description: What the workflows can do for the repository, and who can set them going. None of them deploys.

entities.name: Continuous integration
entities.description: Every pull request is checked: its .dev files validated, each game it changes tested and built, and its database changes held until acknowledged. Nothing is deployed; the owner deploys each game from their own machine.
entities.responsibility: Test and build each game a change touches, and refuse a merge that changes a database nobody has acknowledged migrating.
access: Any pull request runs CI and the Database migration check; the workflows check nobody.
main requires the Database migration check, so it takes only pull requests (AGENTS.md).
No workflow deploys or needs a secret: ci.yml calls game.yml without deploying.

relatedViews.relationship: Migrating a database is enforced by its pull request check.
The workflows and scripts that make it up.
